remarks:
COUNTRY CHARM, CHARACTER & HOMESTEADING POTENTIAL! This inviting 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath farmhouse sits on 1.88 acres and offers the perfect blend of rustic character and comfortable living. Gorgeous woodwork throughout gives the home a warm, timeless feel that is hard to replicate.

The spacious kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry and counter space, along with a convenient breakfast bar. The primary bedroom is conveniently located on the first floor just off the kitchen and features a walk-in closet. First-floor laundry adds everyday convenience, while the remodeled full bath showcases beautiful tile work and a walk-in shower.

Step down into the sunken living room, a cozy gathering space that flows into the dining area. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a convenient half bath.

Step outside and take in the gorgeous hillside views from the wrap-around deck—a wonderful spot to enjoy your morning coffee, entertain, or simply take in the peaceful country setting. The partially fenced yard offers space for pets, gardening, or outdoor activities.

Ready to embrace a little homesteading? The chicken coop and chickens are already here to help get you started! Whether you're dreaming of your own small farm, growing a garden, raising chickens, or simply enjoying more space and privacy, this property offers plenty of possibilities.

1.88 acres, beautiful views, original character, modern updates, and country charm—this is the kind of property that feels like home.
